<!-- Compares several runs of the plans in this repository (api 0.8.0). Not part
     of a run: render it over a directory of output trees, see `make across_backends`.

     Each run directory is named out_<backend>_seed_<seed>_run_<run> and holds
       - the summary.tsv tables written by the `metrics` stage, and
       - performances.tsv, written by `ob collect performance -o <run dir>`.
     Datasets, methods and parameters are read from those tables, never from
     the directory names below a run. -->

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(jsonlite)
})
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, warning = FALSE)

run_pattern <- "^out_([a-z]+)_seed_([0-9]+)_run_([0-9]+)$"
runs <- list.dirs(params$runs_dir, recursive = FALSE)
runs <- runs[grepl(run_pattern, basename(runs))]
stopifnot("no out_<backend>_seed_<seed>_run_<run> directory found" = length(runs) > 0)

run_label <- function(d) {
    m <- regmatches(basename(d), regexec(run_pattern, basename(d)))[[1]]
    data.frame(backend = m[2], seed = factor(m[3]), run = factor(m[4]))
}

# "k=v;k=v" with sorted keys, as the `metrics` stage writes method_params
params_label <- function(p) {
    keys <- sort(names(p), method = "radix")
    paste0(keys, "=", unlist(p[keys]), collapse = ";")
}

module_colours <- c(fcps = "grey70", agglomerative = "salmon", fastcluster = "lightsteelblue",
                    sklearn = "orange", genieclust = "darkgreen")
```

Runs found: `r paste(basename(runs), collapse = ", ")`.

# Clustering metrics

```{r scores}
scores <- lapply(runs, function(d) {
    files <- list.files(d, pattern = "^summary\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    files <- files[!grepl("/by-params/", files)]    # a derived view of the same files
    lapply(files, read.delim, colClasses = c(method_params = "character")) |>
        bind_rows() |>
        cbind(run_label(d))
}) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(data = paste0(dataset_generator, "/", dataset), module = method,
           method = paste0(module, " ", method_params))

table(scores$backend, is.na(scores$score))

ari <- scores |> filter(metric == "adjusted_rand_score", k_position == "k", !is.na(score))
ari_cmp <- inner_join(ari |> filter(backend != params$reference),
                      ari |> filter(backend == params$reference),
                      by = c("seed", "run", "data", "method", "module"),
                      suffix = c("", ".ref"))

ggplot(ari_cmp, aes(score.ref, score, shape = seed, colour = module)) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = module_colours) +
    facet_wrap(~ backend) +
    xlab(paste("Adjusted Rand Index:", params$reference)) +
    ylab("Adjusted Rand Index") +
    theme_classic()
```

Scores that differ from the reference backend by more than 0.001:

```{r}
ari_cmp |>
    filter(abs(score - score.ref) > 0.001) |>
    select(backend, seed, run, data, method, score.ref, score)
```

# Computational performance

Only the clustering nodes, and only those Snakemake measured a CPU time for
(very short jobs have none).

```{r performance}
perf <- lapply(runs, function(d) {
    f <- file.path(d, "performances.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(f)) stop(f, " is missing: run `ob collect performance -o ", d, "`")
    p <- read.delim(f) |> filter(stage == "clustering")
    # per-stage parameter values of each node (the table also has a `lineage` column)
    by_stage <- lapply(p$params, fromJSON)
    p |>
        transmute(data = sapply(by_stage, function(l) paste0(l$data$dataset_generator, "/", l$data$dataset)),
                  method = paste0(module, " ", sapply(by_stage, function(l) params_label(l$clustering))),
                  module, s, cpu_time, max_rss) |>
        cbind(run_label(d))
}) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    filter(!is.na(cpu_time))

perf_cmp <- inner_join(perf |> filter(backend != params$reference),
                       perf |> filter(backend == params$reference),
                       by = c("seed", "run", "data", "method", "module"),
                       suffix = c("", ".ref"))

perf_cmp |>
    group_by(backend) |>
    summarize(n = n(),
              median_cpu_time_ratio = median(cpu_time / cpu_time.ref, na.rm = TRUE),
              median_max_rss_ratio = median(max_rss / max_rss.ref, na.rm = TRUE))

ratio_plot <- function(d, x, y, xlab, ylab) {
    ggplot(d, aes({{ x }}, {{ y }}, shape = seed, colour = module)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .8) +
        scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
        scale_colour_manual(values = module_colours) +
        facet_wrap(~ backend) +
        xlab(xlab) + ylab(ylab) +
        theme_classic()
}
```

## CPU time

```{r}
ratio_plot(perf_cmp |> filter(cpu_time.ref > 0, cpu_time > 0), cpu_time.ref, cpu_time / cpu_time.ref,
           paste("CPU time (s):", params$reference), paste("CPU time ratio to", params$reference))
```

Restricted to jobs above 1 s of CPU time and ratios between 0.5 and 2:

```{r}
long <- perf_cmp |> filter(cpu_time.ref > 1, cpu_time / cpu_time.ref > .5, cpu_time / cpu_time.ref < 2)
long |> group_by(backend) |> summarize(n = n(), median_cpu_time_ratio = median(cpu_time / cpu_time.ref))
if (nrow(long) > 0)
    ratio_plot(long, cpu_time.ref, cpu_time / cpu_time.ref,
               paste("CPU time (s):", params$reference), paste("CPU time ratio to", params$reference))
```

## Memory

```{r}
ratio_plot(perf_cmp |> filter(!is.na(max_rss), !is.na(max_rss.ref)), max_rss.ref, max_rss / max_rss.ref,
           paste("Maximum RSS (MB):", params$reference), paste("Maximum RSS ratio to", params$reference))
```
